core.text: Hypothesis: the generation-to-inspection interface carries diagnostic obstruction by handing a new full run to the newest-run tail. Execution still generates the initiating record; the automatic selected interval hides it. Both parent operations remain intact.

Proposed interface ablation: suppress only the automatic handoff into the next inspected view by explicitly assigning retained run-2 full view after execution. P1 still performs one full rerun, charges time, advances history and generates its default; P2 still selects and inspects evidence. The default no longer determines the inspected interval.

Reset separate synthetic repetitions to completed run-1. Hold the diagnosis demand and one full rerun fixed. Linked control inspects the resulting run-2 tail; ablated arm explicitly selects run-2 full view. Each pays four execution minutes and one view minute. Record selected intervals, initiating visibility, next requested action and any additional executed actions.

Hypothesized surviving outcome: after the ablated view, commit B2, CONFIG missing region, run-2, line 8 before scoring, with run-1 and run-2 retained. Five stipulated action minutes leave budget headroom; commitment cost is unspecified. This exercise has not occurred. A second full rerun violates the valued rerun limit and removes run-1.

The interface carries the proposed behavioral result only if changing its inspected interval changes subsequent requests or supported commitments under the same exercised policy. Unchanged actions fail to support that claim. O5 supplies a trace, not the causes of its choices.

residue.text: B7 prerequisite B2 unavailable identifies a dependency but omits the configuration message. An interface that merely redirects inspection to B7 cannot support the complete initiating citation. Focused B2 could supply it, but substituting a focused execution would change the controlled parent action.

Proposed negative control: repeat with line 8 replaced by progress. Full visibility must not produce a scored B2 CONFIG diagnosis from absent evidence. Procedural concealment cannot guarantee blinding.

No actual operator response, cognitive effort, live CI benefit or generalization is established. Fresh execution may matter for changing failures; this intervention concerns an unchanged synthetic fixture.

tension.account_a: Hypothesis: inspected visibility transmitted through the execution-inspection handoff changes the following rerun demand.
tension.account_b: Incompatible hypothesis: the exercised policy requests further reruns independently of the inspected interval.
tension.prediction_a: After identical full execution, the ablated full view should reduce subsequent rerun requests and enable a viewed-record commitment compared with the linked tail.
tension.prediction_b: After identical full execution, subsequent rerun requests should remain unchanged across linked tail and ablated full views, despite different initiating-record visibility.
